```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE,
                      fig.height = 5, fig.width = 7, dpi = 150)
```

# 1. Libraries

```{r libraries}
library(tidyverse)
library(ggrepel)
library(ggpubr)
```

# 2. Parameters

```{r params}
dir_02   <- "F:/wd/cohort7_miRNAs/external validation/output/02_GSE155096_homolog"
dir_021  <- "F:/wd/cohort7_miRNAs/external validation/output/02.1_target_Jaccard"
dir_out  <- "F:/wd/cohort7_miRNAs/external validation/output/02.2_Jaccard_CvsT"
dir.create(dir_out, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

MIRNA_CLUSTER_COLORS <- c(
  "1" = "#B3E2CD", "2" = "#FDCDAC", "3" = "#CBD5E8",
  "4" = "#F4CAE4", "5" = "#FFF2AE"
)

cat("Output dir:", dir_out, "\n")
```

# 3. Load data

```{r load}
# read_csv() (readr) always returns a tibble; avoids na.print dispatch errors
# that occur when print(x, n = Inf) is called on a base data.frame.
cvst <- read_csv(file.path(dir_02, "CvsT_stats.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
jac  <- read_csv(file.path(dir_021, "jaccard_hsa_mmu_target_overlap.csv"),
                 show_col_types = FALSE)

cat("CvsT pairs  :", nrow(cvst), "\n")
cat("Jaccard pairs:", nrow(jac),  "\n")
```

# 4. Join and prepare analysis dataset

```{r join}
df <- cvst %>%
  inner_join(jac %>% dplyr::select(mmu_miRNA, hsa_miRNA, jaccard_index,
                                    n_hsa, n_mmu, n_intersect, n_union),
             by = c("mmu_miRNA", "hsa_miRNA")) %>%
  mutate(
    abs_log2FC    = abs(log2FC),
    sig           = factor(sig, levels = c("FDR < 0.05", "p < 0.05", "n.s.")),
    direction     = factor(direction, levels = c("Up in T", "Down in T")),
    miRNA_cluster = factor(as.character(miRNA_cluster), levels = 1:5),
    pair_label    = paste0(sub("^mmu-", "", mmu_miRNA), " / ",
                           sub("^hsa-", "", hsa_miRNA))
  )

cat("Joined pairs:", nrow(df), "\n")
cat("NA in jaccard_index:", sum(is.na(df$jaccard_index)), "\n")

# Note: Jaccard is computed at the miR-family level (TargetScan), so pairs within
# the same family share identical Jaccard values but have distinct log2FC values.
family_share <- df %>%
  count(miR_family, jaccard_index) %>%
  filter(n > 1)
cat("Families with shared Jaccard values:", nrow(family_share), "\n")

print(df %>% dplyr::select(mmu_miRNA, hsa_miRNA, miRNA_cluster,
                             log2FC, p_adj, sig, jaccard_index), n = Inf)

write.csv(df, file.path(dir_out, "joined_Jaccard_CvsT.csv"),
          row.names = FALSE, quote = TRUE)
cat("Saved: joined_Jaccard_CvsT.csv\n")
```

# 5. Correlation: Jaccard index vs log2FC

## 5a. Spearman correlation test

```{r spearman-fc}
cor_fc <- cor.test(df$jaccard_index, df$log2FC,
                   method = "spearman", exact = FALSE)
cat("Spearman rho (Jaccard vs log2FC):", round(cor_fc$estimate, 3),
    "  p =", signif(cor_fc$p.value, 3), "\n")
```

## 5b. Spearman correlation: Jaccard vs |log2FC|

```{r spearman-absfc}
cor_abs <- cor.test(df$jaccard_index, df$abs_log2FC,
                    method = "spearman", exact = FALSE)
cat("Spearman rho (Jaccard vs |log2FC|):", round(cor_abs$estimate, 3),
    "  p =", signif(cor_abs$p.value, 3), "\n")
```

# 6. Visualization

## 6a. Scatter: Jaccard index vs log2FC

```{r scatter-fc, fig.height=6, fig.width=7}
anno_fc <- sprintf("Spearman ρ = %.3f\np = %s",
                   cor_fc$estimate, signif(cor_fc$p.value, 3))

p_sc_fc <- ggplot(df, aes(x = jaccard_index, y = log2FC,
                            color = miRNA_cluster, shape = sig)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "grey60", linewidth = 0.5, linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_point(size = 3, alpha = 0.85) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, color = "grey30",
              linewidth = 0.7, linetype = "solid", inherit.aes = FALSE,
              aes(x = jaccard_index, y = log2FC)) +
  geom_text_repel(aes(label = pair_label), size = 2.8,
                  max.overlaps = 15, show.legend = FALSE) +
  scale_color_manual(name = "Mouse\ncluster", values = MIRNA_CLUSTER_COLORS) +
  scale_shape_manual(name = "Significance",
                     values = c("FDR < 0.05" = 8, "p < 0.05" = 17, "n.s." = 16)) +
  annotate("text", x = Inf, y = Inf, hjust = 1.05, vjust = 1.5,
           label = anno_fc, size = 3.5, color = "grey20") +
  labs(
    title    = "Jaccard index vs log2FC (C vs T, GSE155096)",
    subtitle = "Functional conservation of target mRNAs vs expression change",
    x        = "Jaccard index (hsa–mmu target mRNA overlap)",
    y        = "log2FC (Treatment − Control)"
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    plot.title    = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(color = "grey40", hjust = 0.5, size = 9)
  )

print(p_sc_fc)

ggsave(file.path(dir_out, "scatter_Jaccard_vs_log2FC.svg"), p_sc_fc,
       width = 7, height = 6)
ggsave(file.path(dir_out, "scatter_Jaccard_vs_log2FC.png"), p_sc_fc,
       width = 7, height = 6, dpi = 300)
cat("Saved: scatter_Jaccard_vs_log2FC\n")
```

## 6b. Scatter: Jaccard index vs |log2FC|

```{r scatter-absfc, fig.height=6, fig.width=7}
anno_abs <- sprintf("Spearman ρ = %.3f\np = %s",
                    cor_abs$estimate, signif(cor_abs$p.value, 3))

p_sc_abs <- ggplot(df, aes(x = jaccard_index, y = abs_log2FC,
                             color = miRNA_cluster, shape = sig)) +
  geom_point(size = 3, alpha = 0.85) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, color = "grey30",
              linewidth = 0.7, inherit.aes = FALSE,
              aes(x = jaccard_index, y = abs_log2FC)) +
  geom_text_repel(aes(label = pair_label), size = 2.8,
                  max.overlaps = 15, show.legend = FALSE) +
  scale_color_manual(name = "Mouse\ncluster", values = MIRNA_CLUSTER_COLORS) +
  scale_shape_manual(name = "Significance",
                     values = c("FDR < 0.05" = 8, "p < 0.05" = 17, "n.s." = 16)) +
  annotate("text", x = Inf, y = Inf, hjust = 1.05, vjust = 1.5,
           label = anno_abs, size = 3.5, color = "grey20") +
  labs(
    title    = "Jaccard index vs |log2FC| (C vs T, GSE155096)",
    subtitle = "Functional conservation vs magnitude of expression change",
    x        = "Jaccard index (hsa–mmu target mRNA overlap)",
    y        = "|log2FC|"
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    plot.title    = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(color = "grey40", hjust = 0.5, size = 9)
  )

print(p_sc_abs)

ggsave(file.path(dir_out, "scatter_Jaccard_vs_abslog2FC.svg"), p_sc_abs,
       width = 7, height = 6)
ggsave(file.path(dir_out, "scatter_Jaccard_vs_abslog2FC.png"), p_sc_abs,
       width = 7, height = 6, dpi = 300)
cat("Saved: scatter_Jaccard_vs_abslog2FC\n")
```

## 6c. Boxplot: Jaccard by significance category

```{r boxplot-sig, fig.height=5, fig.width=5}
# Wilcoxon pairwise comparisons
sig_pairs <- list(c("FDR < 0.05", "n.s."), c("p < 0.05", "n.s."),
                  c("FDR < 0.05", "p < 0.05"))

p_box_sig <- ggplot(df, aes(x = sig, y = jaccard_index, fill = sig)) +
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.5, outlier.shape = NA, linewidth = 0.6, alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.12, size = 2.5, alpha = 0.8, color = "grey25") +
  stat_compare_means(comparisons = sig_pairs, method = "wilcox.test",
                     label = "p.format", size = 3.2) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c("FDR < 0.05" = "#d6604d", "p < 0.05" = "#f4a582", "n.s." = "#92c5de"),
    guide  = "none"
  ) +
  labs(
    title    = "Jaccard index by significance (C vs T)",
    subtitle = "Wilcoxon test",
    x        = NULL,
    y        = "Jaccard index"
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    plot.title    = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(color = "grey40", hjust = 0.5, size = 9),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank()
  )

print(p_box_sig)

ggsave(file.path(dir_out, "boxplot_Jaccard_by_sig.svg"), p_box_sig,
       width = 5, height = 5)
ggsave(file.path(dir_out, "boxplot_Jaccard_by_sig.png"), p_box_sig,
       width = 5, height = 5, dpi = 300)
cat("Saved: boxplot_Jaccard_by_sig\n")
```

## 6d. Boxplot: Jaccard by expression direction

```{r boxplot-dir, fig.height=5, fig.width=4}
p_box_dir <- ggplot(df, aes(x = direction, y = jaccard_index, fill = direction)) +
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.45, outlier.shape = NA, linewidth = 0.6, alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.1, size = 2.5, alpha = 0.8, color = "grey25") +
  stat_compare_means(method = "wilcox.test", label = "p.format",
                     label.x = 1.5, size = 3.5) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c("Up in T" = "#fc9272", "Down in T" = "#9ecae1"),
    guide  = "none"
  ) +
  labs(
    title    = "Jaccard index by expression direction",
    subtitle = "Up vs Down in Treatment (C vs T)",
    x        = NULL,
    y        = "Jaccard index"
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    plot.title    = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(color = "grey40", hjust = 0.5, size = 9),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank()
  )

print(p_box_dir)

ggsave(file.path(dir_out, "boxplot_Jaccard_by_direction.svg"), p_box_dir,
       width = 4, height = 5)
ggsave(file.path(dir_out, "boxplot_Jaccard_by_direction.png"), p_box_dir,
       width = 4, height = 5, dpi = 300)
cat("Saved: boxplot_Jaccard_by_direction\n")
```

## 6e. Boxplot: Jaccard by mouse maSigPro cluster

```{r boxplot-cluster, fig.height=5, fig.width=6}
# Kruskal-Wallis + pairwise Wilcoxon
kw_res <- kruskal.test(jaccard_index ~ miRNA_cluster, data = df)
cat("Kruskal-Wallis: chi2 =", round(kw_res$statistic, 3),
    "  p =", signif(kw_res$p.value, 3), "\n")

p_box_clst <- ggplot(df, aes(x = miRNA_cluster, y = jaccard_index,
                               fill = miRNA_cluster)) +
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.5, outlier.shape = NA, linewidth = 0.6, alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.12, size = 2.5, alpha = 0.8, color = "grey25") +
  scale_fill_manual(name = "Cluster", values = MIRNA_CLUSTER_COLORS) +
  annotate("text", x = Inf, y = Inf, hjust = 1.05, vjust = 1.5,
           label = sprintf("Kruskal-Wallis\np = %s", signif(kw_res$p.value, 3)),
           size = 3.5, color = "grey20") +
  labs(
    title    = "Jaccard index by mouse maSigPro cluster",
    x        = "Mouse cluster",
    y        = "Jaccard index"
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    plot.title         = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank()
  )

print(p_box_clst)

ggsave(file.path(dir_out, "boxplot_Jaccard_by_cluster.svg"), p_box_clst,
       width = 6, height = 5)
ggsave(file.path(dir_out, "boxplot_Jaccard_by_cluster.png"), p_box_clst,
       width = 6, height = 5, dpi = 300)
cat("Saved: boxplot_Jaccard_by_cluster\n")
```

## 6f. Scatter by cluster (facet)

```{r scatter-facet, fig.height=8, fig.width=9}
clst_levels <- sort(unique(as.integer(as.character(df$miRNA_cluster))))

p_facet <- ggplot(df, aes(x = jaccard_index, y = log2FC, shape = sig)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "grey60", linewidth = 0.4, linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_point(aes(color = miRNA_cluster), size = 2.5, alpha = 0.85) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, color = "grey30",
              linewidth = 0.6, inherit.aes = FALSE,
              aes(x = jaccard_index, y = log2FC)) +
  geom_text_repel(aes(label = pair_label, color = miRNA_cluster),
                  size = 2.5, max.overlaps = 8, show.legend = FALSE) +
  stat_cor(method = "spearman", label.x.npc = 0.05, label.y.npc = 0.95,
           size = 3, cor.coef.name = "rho") +
  scale_color_manual(name = "Cluster", values = MIRNA_CLUSTER_COLORS) +
  scale_shape_manual(name = "Significance",
                     values = c("FDR < 0.05" = 8, "p < 0.05" = 17, "n.s." = 16)) +
  facet_wrap(~ miRNA_cluster, labeller = label_both,
             scales = "free", ncol = 2) +
  labs(
    title    = "Jaccard index vs log2FC by mouse cluster",
    x        = "Jaccard index",
    y        = "log2FC (Treatment − Control)"
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 11) +
  theme(
    plot.title  = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey92"),
    strip.text  = element_text(face = "bold")
  )

print(p_facet)

ggsave(file.path(dir_out, "scatter_Jaccard_vs_log2FC_by_cluster.svg"), p_facet,
       width = 9, height = 8)
ggsave(file.path(dir_out, "scatter_Jaccard_vs_log2FC_by_cluster.png"), p_facet,
       width = 9, height = 8, dpi = 300)
cat("Saved: scatter_Jaccard_vs_log2FC_by_cluster\n")
```

# 7. Summary statistics

```{r summary-stats}
# Correlation by significance group
cor_by_sig <- df %>%
  group_by(sig) %>%
  summarise(
    n        = n(),
    mean_jac = round(mean(jaccard_index, na.rm = TRUE), 4),
    sd_jac   = round(sd(jaccard_index,   na.rm = TRUE), 4),
    mean_fc  = round(mean(log2FC,         na.rm = TRUE), 3),
    .groups  = "drop"
  )

cat("Summary by significance:\n")
print(cor_by_sig)

# Correlation by cluster
cor_by_clst <- df %>%
  group_by(miRNA_cluster) %>%
  summarise(
    n        = n(),
    mean_jac = round(mean(jaccard_index, na.rm = TRUE), 4),
    sd_jac   = round(sd(jaccard_index,   na.rm = TRUE), 4),
    rho_jac_fc = tryCatch(
      round(cor(jaccard_index, log2FC, method = "spearman", use = "complete.obs"), 3),
      error = function(e) NA_real_
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

cat("\nSummary by cluster:\n")
print(cor_by_clst)

# Overall summary table
summary_tbl <- tibble(
  comparison          = c("Jaccard vs log2FC", "Jaccard vs |log2FC|"),
  spearman_rho        = round(c(cor_fc$estimate, cor_abs$estimate), 3),
  p_value             = signif(c(cor_fc$p.value, cor_abs$p.value), 3),
  n_pairs             = nrow(df)
)

cat("\nCorrelation summary:\n")
print(summary_tbl)

write.csv(summary_tbl,
          file.path(dir_out, "correlation_summary.csv"),
          row.names = FALSE, quote = TRUE)
cat("Saved: correlation_summary.csv\n")
```
